title: Text Corpora as Concept Fields: Black-Box Hallucination and Novelty Measurement
abstract: arXiv:2605.05103v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We introduce the \textbf{Concept Field} of a text corpus: a local drift field with pointwise uncertainty, estimated in sentence-embedding space from the deltas between consecutive sentences. Given a candidate sentence transition, we score its agreement with the field by $\zeta$, the mean absolute z-distance between the observed delta and the field's local Gaussian estimate. The score is black-box (no model internals), corpus-attributable (every score traces to nearby corpus sentences), and admits a probabilistically motivated interpretation under a local Gaussian approximation. We support the computation with the introduction of a \textbf{Vector Sequence Database (VSDB)} that stores embeddings together with sequence-position and next-delta metadata. We evaluate this approach on two large-scale settings: hallucination-style groundedness detection over the U.S. Code of Federal Regulations, and novelty detection over Project Guten

translated_title: 文本语料库作为概念场：黑盒幻觉与新颖性度量
translated_abstract: 我们引入了文本语料库的**概念场**：一个具有逐点不确定性的局部漂移场，在句子嵌入空间中通过连续句子之间的增量来估计。给定一个候选句子转换，我们通过$\zeta$（观测增量与场的局部高斯估计之间的平均绝对z距离）来评分其与场的一致性。该评分是黑盒的（无需模型内部信息）、可归因于语料库的（每个评分都可追溯到附近的语料库句子），并在局部高斯近似下具有概率动机的解释。我们通过引入**向量序列数据库（VSDB）**来支持计算，该数据库存储嵌入以及序列位置和下一增量元数据。我们在两个大规模场景中评估了这种方法：对美国联邦法规中的幻觉式接地检测，以及对古腾堡计划文本的新颖性检测。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于语料库概念场的黑盒方法，通过句子嵌入空间中的局部漂移场来度量幻觉和新颖性，无需模型内部信息且可归因于语料库。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a black-box method based on corpus concept fields, using local drift fields in sentence-embedding space to measure hallucination and novelty, requiring no model internals and attributable to the corpus.
